mainTabIpHelp: Enter the IP address or hostname of your FRITZ!Box (e.g. fritz.box).
mainTabUserHelp: Create a user in the FRITZ!Box menu 'System » FRITZ!Box Users » Users'. Grant this user the 'FRITZ!Box Settings' access right.
mainTabPwHelp: Enter the password of your FRITZ!Box user.
mainTabSslHelp: Disable this option if you have problems connecting to your FRITZ!Box.
mainTabSslCertHelp: Checks whether the HTTPS certificate is valid and trustworthy. Self-signed certificates are rejected.
mainTabhistoryHelp: Select the History adapter to store and evaluate family member data points.
mainTabdateformatHelp: Specify the date format used in HTML tables. See the dateformat documentation for available format options.
mainTabIntervalHelp: Set the polling interval between 10 and 3600 seconds.
mainTabfbdevicesLabel: Create data points for FRITZ!Box devices
mainTabfbdevicesHelp: Enable this option to create data points for FRITZ!Box devices.
mainTabvalidatortext_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address, or hostname.
mainTabuseDeviceListHelp: Enable this option to create data points only for the FRITZ!Box devices selected. Disable it to create data points for all FRITZ!Box devices. Changing the selection does not delete existing data points; remove any unwanted ones manually.
mainTabDevicelistHelp: Select the FRITZ!Box devices for which data points should be created. Devices that share a hostname are represented by one set of data points; selecting any of their entries includes all devices with that hostname.
mainTabMeshHelp: Enable this option to create additional data points for devices and interfaces in your FRITZ!Box mesh network.
mainTabFbsyncHelp: Enable this option to synchronize the FRITZ!Box device data points once.
mainTabSyncfbdevicesMaxDaysHelp: Set the number of days after which inactive FRITZ!Box device data points are removed during synchronization. Set to 0 to disable this cleanup.
mainTabGuestHelp: Enable this option to retrieve guest network information.
mainTabQrHelp: Enable this option to generate a QR code for the guest Wi-Fi network.
mainTabQrcolorHelp: Specify the color of the QR code.
mainTabextipHelp: Enable this option to retrieve your external IP address.
fmTabIntervalHelp: Set the polling interval between 10 and 3600 seconds.
fmTabCompatibilityHelp: The way family members are handled has changed. See the relevant notice in the adapter log for details.
fmTabDelayHelp: Set the filter delay between 1 and 300 seconds.
fmTabFamilymembersValidatorError: Please fill in the MAC address, family member, hostname, and IP address fields in every enabled row.
fmTabNewfilterHelp: The new filter function only works if a History adapter is enabled and configured.
wlTabEnableHelp: Enable this option to use the whitelist and blacklist. You can then specify which FRITZ!Box devices are known and should be excluded from the blacklist.
wlTabSelectLabel: Choose Fritzbox devices for the whitelist
